assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient is accompanied by episodes of dizziness
The patient had a recent event of syncope
The Holter monitor is used to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management
The service is medically necessary to evaluate palpitations, dizziness, and syncope in the context of diagnosed supraventricular tachycardia
CPT code 93226 is used for the 48-hour Holter monitor
The diagnosis code I47.1 is used for supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis code R42 is used for dizziness
